Name: Marnie Makeover
Author: ApryllForever
Description:
A makeover for Marnie's sprites, portrait, even her wedding dancing, and also a small fix for her schedule, to help her not lurk around the microwave! She will now have her store open seven days a week. Monday the store is open from 12 pm - 4 pm. Tuesday the store is open from 7 am - 10 am. She still goes to the Seed Shop on Monday, just earlier in the day. She still follows her regular exercise schedule. 

Additionally, this mod makes Marnie's House open from 7 AM - 7 PM every day. She is usually available at 7:00, except Monday morning, wherein she leaves for the Seed Shop at 6:10. So, an early start will nearly always get your hungry animals that much needed hay or let you buy that Duckie so you can get a friend for your chickies and also get a feather for the Junimos!

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]



[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode; all players must have the mod installed. 
[/list]
